question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**written**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need the **past particle **of **write **since we are talking about an event in the past.
 
• So **written **would be the appropriate verb form for the given sentence.
 
 
• **Example**: *They decided to sign the **written **__agreement for separation from the marriage*.
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**

**The complete passage is**: *Castles are home to a rich history. From blood feuds to tragic pasts, (1) **from** love affairs to alleged ghosts, no castle is ever (2)**without **a secret to unveil. Known locally as Chateaux Picomtal, Picomtal Castle (3) **recently** came under new ownership. During renovation of the(4)**property**, a surprising discovery was made. Messages **(5) written **long ago were found on the floorboards of **(6) the **upper chambers. The messages were written **(7)between**1880 and 1881 by Joachim Martin; the carpenter__ __**(8)who **installed the flooring. His messages were a diary of 72 entries of his daily __**(**__**9) life**, personal thoughts along with his emotions and feelings. Joachim’s** (10)diary **is indeed a very personal account of the history of those times. The discovery gives us an honest look at an average person’s daily life over 135 years ago.*
